<!DOCTYPE html>
<html>
<head>
    <meta charset="UTF-8">
        <style>
            * {
                margin: 0;
                padding: 0;
                box-sizing: border-box;
            }
            
            body {
                font-family: Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif;
                font-size: 9pt;
                line-height: 1.4;
                color: #000;
                background: white;
            }
            
            .receipt-container {
                width: 100%;
                max-width: 210mm;
                margin: 0 auto;
                padding: 0;
                background: white;
                position: relative;
                display: flex;
                flex-direction: column;
                min-height: 273mm;
            }

            .print-format .receipt-container {
                flex: 1 1 auto;
                min-height: 100%;
            }
            
            @media screen {
                html, body {
                    overflow-x: hidden;
                    overflow-y: auto;
                }
            }
            
            .receipt-body {
                flex: 1 1 auto;
                display: flex;
                flex-direction: column;
                min-height: 0;
            }

            .top-section {
                flex: 1 1 auto;
                display: flex;
                flex-direction: column;
                min-height: 0;
            }

            .last-page-push {
                height: var(--last-page-push-height, 0);
                flex-shrink: 0;
            }

            .receipt-container.single-page-invoice {
                display: flex;
                flex-direction: column;
                min-height: 273mm;
            }

            .receipt-container.single-page-invoice .receipt-body {
                flex: 1 1 auto;
                display: flex;
                flex-direction: column;
                min-height: 0;
            }

            .receipt-container.single-page-invoice .top-section {
                flex: 1 1 auto;
                display: flex;
                flex-direction: column;
                min-height: 0;
            }

            .receipt-container.single-page-invoice .last-page-block {
                margin-top: auto;
                flex-shrink: 0;
            }
            
            /* Header Section */
            .header {
                display: flex;
                justify-content: space-between;
                align-items: center;
                margin-bottom: 3mm;
            }
            
            .logo-placeholder {
                width: 60mm;
                height: 30mm;
                background: #e0e0e0;
                border: 1px solid #ccc;
                display: flex;
                align-items: center;
                justify-content: center;
                font-size: 7pt;
                color: #666;
            }
            
            .company-logo {
                width: 60mm;
                height: 30mm;
                object-fit: contain;
            }
            
            .company-info {
                flex: 1;
                text-align: left;
                padding-left: 3mm;
            }
            
            .company-name {
                font-size: 16pt;
                font-weight: bold;
                margin-bottom: 0;
            }
            
            .company-address {
                font-size: 7pt;
                line-height: 1.3;
                margin-bottom: 0;
            }
            
            .vat-reg {
                font-size: 7pt;
            }
            
            .company-contact {
                font-size: 7pt;
                line-height: 1.3;
            }
            
            /* Document Title */
            .document-title {
                text-align: center;
                font-size: 18pt;
                font-weight: 900;
                margin: 3mm 0;
            }
            
            /* Separator Line */
            .separator {
                border-bottom: 1px solid #000;
                margin: 3mm 0;
            }
            
            /* Invoice & Job Info blocks - harmonized, compact */
            .info-block {
                border: 2px solid #000;
                padding: 1mm 1.5mm;
                font-size: 7.5pt;
                page-break-inside: avoid;
            }
            .info-block .info-title {
                font-weight: 900;
                font-size: 8pt;
                margin-bottom: 1mm;
                border-bottom: 1px solid #000;
                padding-bottom: 0.5mm;
                letter-spacing: 0.02em;
            }
            .info-block .field-row {
                display: flex;
                margin-bottom: 0.2mm;
                align-items: center;
                gap: 1.5mm;
                min-height: 3.5mm;
            }
            .info-block .field-label {
                font-weight: bold;
                font-size: 7.5pt;
                min-width: 26mm;
                flex-shrink: 0;
                text-align: left;
            }
            .info-block .field-value {
                flex: 1;
                font-size: 7.5pt;
                min-width: 0;
            }
            
            /* Main Body - Invoice Information (two columns) */
            .main-body {
                display: flex;
                flex-direction: column;
                justify-content: flex-start;
                margin-bottom: 0;
                margin-top: 35mm;
                position: relative;
            }
            .main-body .info-block {
                margin-top: 0;
                margin-bottom: 0;
            }
            .main-body .info-content {
                display: flex;
                justify-content: space-between;
                align-items: flex-start;
                gap: 6mm;
            }
            .left-column,
            .right-column {
                flex: 1 1 0;
                min-width: 0;
                padding: 0;
                display: grid;
                grid-template-columns: max-content 1fr;
                column-gap: 0;
                row-gap: 0.2mm;
                align-items: center;
                align-content: start;
                grid-auto-rows: min-content;
            }
            .left-column .field-row,
            .right-column .field-row {
                display: contents;
            }
            .main-body .info-block .field-label {
                display: flex;
                justify-content: space-between;
                align-items: center;
                gap: 1.5mm;
                width: auto;
                min-width: 0;
                text-align: left;
            }
            .main-body .info-block .field-label::after {
                content: ": ";
                flex-shrink: 0;
            }
            .main-body .info-block.note-info .left-column .field-value {
                white-space: nowrap;
            }
            
            .field-row {
                display: flex;
                margin-bottom: 0.2mm;
                align-items: flex-start;
                gap: 1.5mm;
            }
            .field-label {
                font-weight: bold;
                min-width: 22mm;
                font-size: 7.5pt;
                flex-shrink: 0;
                text-align: right;
            }
            .field-value {
                flex: 1;
                font-size: 7.5pt;
                min-height: 3.5mm;
                padding: 0.2mm 0.3mm;
                background: white;
            }
    
            /* Job Information Section - same 2-column layout as Invoice Information */
            .job-information-section {
                display: block;
                margin-top: 1.5mm;
                page-break-inside: avoid;
            }
            .job-information-section .info-content {
                display: flex;
                justify-content: space-between;
                align-items: flex-start;
                gap: 6mm;
            }
            .main-body .job-information-section .left-column,
            .main-body .job-information-section .right-column {
                justify-items: start;
            }
            .main-body .job-information-section .field-label {
                justify-content: flex-start;
                width: max-content;
                min-width: 0;
            }
            .main-body .job-information-section.info-block .field-label::after {
                content: none;
            }
            .main-body .job-information-section .field-value::before {
                content: ": ";
            }
        
        /* Customer Info Section - Aligned with QR */
            .customer-info-section {
                position: absolute;
                top: -35mm;
                left: 1.5mm;
                z-index: 10;
                max-width: 80mm;
            }
            
            .customer-label {
                font-weight: bold;
                font-size: 8pt;
                margin-top: 5mm;
                margin-bottom: 2mm;
                line-height: 1;
            }
            
            .customer-name-box {
                font-size: 11pt;
                font-weight: bold;
                font-weight: 900;
                margin-bottom: 0.1mm;
                margin-top: -1mm;
                line-height: 1;
                background: white;
            }
            
            .customer-address-box {
                font-size: 8pt;
                background: white;
                width: 100mm;
            }
            
            .customer-detail-row {
                font-size: 8pt;
                margin-top: 0.5mm;
                line-height: 1.2;
            }
            .customer-detail-label {
                font-weight: bold;
            }
            .customer-detail-value {
                margin-left: 0.5mm;
            }
            
            /* QR Code Section */
            .qr-section {
                position: absolute;
                top: auto;
                bottom: 100%;
                right: 1.5mm;
                text-align: right;
                z-index: 10;
                margin-bottom: 0;
            }
            
            .qr-placeholder {
                width: 25mm;
                height: 25mm;
                background: #f5f5f5;
                border: 1px solid #ccc;
                margin-bottom: 0.5mm;
                display: inline-block;
            }
            
            .qr-code {
                width: 1in;
                height: 1in;
                border: none;
                display: block;
                margin-left: auto;
            }
            
            .receipt-title-qr {
                font-size: 14pt;
                font-weight: bold;
                font-weight: 900;
                margin-top: 0.11mm;
                margin-bottom: 0;
                text-align: right;
                text-transform: uppercase;
                line-height: 1;
            }
            
            .reference-number {
                font-size: 8pt;
                font-weight: regular;
                margin: 0;
                padding: 0;
                line-height: 1;
            }
            
            /* Table Section */
            .table-summary-container {
                display: flex;
                flex-direction: column;
                gap: 0.5mm;
                flex: 0 0 auto;
                min-height: 0;
            }
            
            .invoice-table {
                width: 100%;
                border-collapse: collapse;
                border-spacing: 0;
                margin-top: 0;
                border: none;
                line-height: 1;
                table-layout: fixed;
            }

            .invoice-table thead {
                display: table-header-group;
            }

            .invoice-table tbody {
                display: table-row-group;
            }

            .invoice-table tfoot {
                display: table-footer-group;
            }
            
            .invoice-table th:nth-child(1),
            .invoice-table td:nth-child(1) {
                width: 5%;
            }
            
            .invoice-table th:nth-child(2),
            .invoice-table td:nth-child(2) {
                width: 9%;
            }
            
            .invoice-table th:nth-child(3),
            .invoice-table td:nth-child(3) {
                width: 36%;
            }
            
            .invoice-table th:nth-child(4),
            .invoice-table td:nth-child(4) {
                width: 18%;
            }
            
            .invoice-table th:nth-child(5),
            .invoice-table td:nth-child(5) {
                width: 14%;
            }
            
            .invoice-table th:nth-child(6),
            .invoice-table td:nth-child(6) {
                width: 18%;
            }
            
            /* DSB: 5 columns (no Tax) - adjust last column width */
            .invoice-table.dsb-no-tax-column th:nth-child(5),
            .invoice-table.dsb-no-tax-column td:nth-child(5) {
                width: 25%;
            }
            
            .table-header {
                background: transparent;
            }
            
            .table-header th {
                padding: 0;
                text-align: left;
                font-size: 8pt;
                font-weight: bold;
                border: none;
                line-height: 1.0;
            }
            
            .table-header tr:first-child th {
                background: #e0e0e0;
                color: #000;
                text-transform: uppercase;
                padding: 0.02mm 0.05mm;
                line-height: 1.0;
                border-top: 2px solid #000;
                border-bottom: 2px solid #000;
                border-left: none;
                border-right: none;
                height: 12px;
            }
            
            .table-header tr:first-child th:first-child {
                text-align: left;
                border-top: 2px solid #000 !important;
                border-bottom: 2px solid #000 !important;
                border-left: 2px solid #000 !important;
                border-right: none !important;
            }
            
            .table-header tr:first-child th:nth-child(2),
            .table-header tr:first-child th:nth-child(3) {
                border-top: 2px solid #000 !important;
                border-bottom: 2px solid #000 !important;
                border-left: none !important;
                border-right: none !important;
            }
            
            .table-header tr:first-child th:nth-child(4),
            .table-header tr:first-child th:nth-child(5) {
                border-top: 2px solid #000 !important;
                border-bottom: 2px solid #000 !important;
                border-left: none !important;
                border-right: none !important;
                text-align: right;
            }
            
            .table-header tr:first-child th:last-child,
            .table-header tr:first-child th:nth-child(6) {
                text-align: right;
                border-top: 2px solid #000 !important;
                border-bottom: 2px solid #000 !important;
                border-left: none !important;
                border-right: 2px solid #000 !important;
            }
            
            .invoice-table .table-row td {
                padding: 1mm 0.1mm !important;
                font-size: 8pt;
                background: white;
                border: none;
                text-align: left;
                vertical-align: top;
                line-height: 1 !important;
                height: auto;
            }
            
            .table-row td:nth-child(1) {
                text-align: center;
            }
            
            .table-row td:nth-child(2),
            .table-row td:nth-child(3) {
                text-align: left;
            }
            
            .table-row td:nth-child(4),
            .table-row td:nth-child(5),
            .table-row td:nth-child(6) {
                text-align: right;
            }
            
            .table-row.summary-row td {
                border-bottom: none;
                padding-top: 0.05mm;
            }
            
            .table-row.summary-row td:last-child {
                border-bottom: 1px solid #000;
                padding-bottom: 0.3mm;
            }
            
            .invoice-description {
                display: inline;
                font-size: 8pt;
                color: #000;
                line-height: 1.2;
            }
            
            /* Right-aligned Summary Table */
            .right-summary-table {
                width: 45%;
                margin-left: auto;
                border-collapse: collapse;
                margin-top: 1mm;
            }
            
            .right-summary-table td {
                border-bottom: 1px solid #000;
                font-size: 7pt;
                padding: 0.3mm 0.5mm;
                text-align: right;
            }
            
            .right-summary-table td.summary-party {
                text-align: left;
                border-bottom: none;
            }
            
            /* Summary and Received Container */
            .summary-received-container {
                display: flex;
                flex-direction: column;
                margin-top: auto;
            }
            
            /* VAT Summary Section - Two Columns */
            .vat-summary-container {
                display: flex;
                flex-direction: row;
                justify-content: space-between;
                gap: 3mm;
                width: 100%;
                margin-top: 2mm;
                margin-bottom: 2mm;
            }
            
            .vat-left-column {
                flex: 1;
                display: flex;
                flex-direction: column;
                width: 100%;
            }
            
            .vat-left-column .vat-summary-row {
                display: flex !important;
                justify-content: flex-start !important;
                width: 100% !important;
                margin-bottom: 0.5mm !important;
                align-items: center !important;
                gap: 2mm !important;
            }
            
            .vat-left-column .vat-summary-label {
                text-align: right !important;
                font-size: 8pt !important;
                font-weight: bold !important;
                flex: 0 0 auto !important;
                margin-left: 30mm !important;
                min-width: 35mm !important;
            }
            
            .vat-left-column .vat-summary-value {
                text-align: right !important;
                font-size: 8pt !important;
                min-width: 25mm !important;
                flex: 0 0 auto !important;
                margin-left: auto !important;
            }
            
            .vat-right-column {
                flex: 1;
                display: flex;
                flex-direction: column;
            }
            
            .vat-summary-row {
                display: flex;
                justify-content: space-between;
                margin-bottom: 0.5mm;
                align-items: center;
                gap: 1.5mm;
            }
            
            .vat-summary-label {
                font-size: 8pt;
                font-weight: bold;
                text-align: left;
            }
            
            .vat-summary-value {
                font-size: 8pt;
                text-align: right;
                min-width: 25mm;
            }
            
            .vat-total-row {
                border-top: 1px solid #000;
                margin-top: 0.5mm;
                padding-top: 0.8mm;
            }
            
            .vat-total-label {
                font-size: 8pt;
                font-weight: 900;
                text-align: left;
            }
            
            .vat-total-value {
                font-size: 8pt;
                font-weight: 900;
                text-align: right;
                min-width: 25mm;
            }
            
            /* Disclaimer Section - Two Columns (Last Page Footer Only) */
            .disclaimer-container {
                display: flex;
                flex-direction: row;
                justify-content: space-between;
                gap: 3mm;
                width: 100%;
                margin-top: 2mm;
                margin-bottom: 2mm;
                border-top: 1px solid #000;
                padding-top: 1mm;
            }
            
            /* Disclaimer container only appears in last-page-footer */
            .last-page-footer .disclaimer-container {
                margin-top: 2mm;
                margin-bottom: 2mm;
            }
            
            .disclaimer-left-column {
                flex: 1;
                display: flex;
                flex-direction: column;
                font-size: 7pt;
                line-height: 1.3;
            }
            
            .disclaimer-right-column {
                flex: 1;
                display: flex;
                flex-direction: column;
                font-size: 7pt;
                line-height: 1.3;
                padding-left: 10mm;
            }
            
            .disclaimer-title {
                font-weight: bold;
                font-size: 7pt;
                margin-bottom: 0.5mm;
            }
            
            .disclaimer-item {
                margin-bottom: 0.3mm;
            }
            
            /* Payment Info Section */
            .payment-info-section {
                padding: 1.5mm;
                margin-top: 0;
                page-break-inside: avoid;
            }
            
            .payment-info-row {
                display: flex;
                margin-bottom: 0;
                margin-top: 0;
                align-items: center;
                gap: 0.5mm;
                line-height: 1;
                page-break-inside: avoid;
            }
            
            .payment-info-label {
                font-size: 8pt;
                font-weight: bold;
                min-width: 20mm;
                flex-shrink: 0;
                line-height: 1;
                margin: 0;
                padding: 0;
            }
            
            .payment-info-field {
                flex: 1;
                padding: 0.3mm 0.5mm;
                background: white;
                font-size: 8pt;
                min-height: 0;
                line-height: 1;
                margin: 0;
            }
            
            /* Signature Section */
            .signature-section {
                margin-top: 0;
                padding: 0;
                page-break-inside: avoid;
            }
            
            .signature-table {
                width: 100%;
                border-collapse: collapse;
                border: 2px solid #000;
                table-layout: fixed;
            }
            
            .signature-table th {
                padding: 0.3mm 0.5mm;
                text-align: center;
                font-size: 7pt;
                font-weight: bold;
                border: 1px solid #000;
                background: #e0e0e0;
                border-top: 2px solid #000;
                border-bottom: 2px solid #000;
                width: 25%;
            }
            
            .signature-table td {
                width: 25%;
            }
            
            .signature-table th:first-child {
                border-left: 2px solid #000;
            }
            
            .signature-table th:last-child {
                border-right: 2px solid #000;
            }
            
            .signature-table td {
                padding: 2mm 0.5mm 0.3mm 0.5mm;
                text-align: center;
                font-size: 6pt;
                border: 1px solid #000;
                height: 8mm;
                vertical-align: bottom;
            }
            
            .signature-table td:first-child {
                border-left: 2px solid #000;
            }
            
            .signature-table td:last-child {
                border-right: 2px solid #000;
            }
            
            .signature-table tbody tr:last-child td {
                border-bottom: 2px solid #000;
            }
            
            /* DSB: input tax notice (before footer) */
            .dsb-input-tax-notice {
                font-size: 8pt;
                font-weight: bold;
                text-align: center;
                margin: 2mm 0 1mm 0;
                padding: 1mm 0;
            }
            
            /* Footer Section */
            .footer-section {
                margin-top: auto;
                padding-top: 1mm;
                border-top: 1px solid #000;
                font-size: 7pt;
            }
            
            /* Repeating footer for every page */
            .footer-section.repeating-footer {
                margin-top: 4mm;
            }
            
            .bottom-section {
                display: block;
            }

            .last-page-block {
                margin-top: auto;
                flex-shrink: 0;
            }

            .last-page-block.footer-with-table {
                display: flex;
                flex-direction: column;
                page-break-before: avoid;
                break-before: avoid;
            }

            .last-page-block.footer-with-table .last-page-push {
                flex: 1 1 auto;
                min-height: 0;
            }

            .last-page-block.footer-with-table .last-page-footer-group {
                flex-shrink: 0;
            }

            .last-page-block.footer-new-page {
                display: flex;
                flex-direction: column;
                page-break-before: always;
                break-before: page;
                margin-top: 0;
                box-sizing: border-box;
            }

            .last-page-block.footer-new-page .last-page-push {
                flex: 1 1 auto;
                min-height: 0;
            }

            .last-page-block.footer-new-page .last-page-footer-group {
                flex-shrink: 0;
            }

            .last-page-footer-group {
                display: block;
            }

            .last-page-block .disclaimer-container {
                margin-top: 5mm;
            }
            
            /* Last page footer: tax summary + BIR + disclaimer on final page only */
            .last-page-footer .vat-summary-container {
                margin-top: 0;
                margin-bottom: 0;
            }
            /* DSB: Total Amount Due only - right-aligned like tax summary right column */
            .vat-summary-container.dsb-total-only {
                display: flex !important;
                justify-content: flex-end;
                margin-bottom: 2mm;
                margin-top: 2mm;
                width: 100%;
            }
            .vat-summary-container.dsb-total-only .vat-right-column {
                min-width: 50%;
            }
            .vat-summary-container.dsb-total-only .vat-total-row {
                display: flex !important;
            }
            
            .footer-row {
                margin-bottom: 0.5mm;
                line-height: 1.3;
            }
            
            .footer-row:last-child {
                margin-bottom: 0;
            }
            
            /* QR Code */
            .qr-code {
                width: 20mm;
                height: 20mm;
                border: 0px solid #000;
            }
            
            .payment-note {
                font-weight: bold;
                font-size: 8pt;
                font-style: italic;
                margin-top: 1mm;
                margin-bottom: 1mm;
                padding: 0.5mm;
                text-align: center;
            }
            
            @page {
                size: A4;
                margin: 12mm 12mm 12mm 12mm;
            }
            @page {
                @bottom-right {
                    content: "Page " counter(page) " of " counter(pages);
                    font-size: 8pt;
                    font-family: Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif;
                }
            }
            
@media print {
            .receipt-container,
            .print-format .receipt-container {
                min-height: 0;
            }

            .receipt-container.single-page-invoice {
                display: flex;
                flex-direction: column;
                min-height: 273mm;
            }

            .receipt-container.single-page-invoice .receipt-body {
                flex: 1 1 auto;
                display: flex;
                flex-direction: column;
                min-height: 0;
            }

            .receipt-container.single-page-invoice .top-section {
                flex: 1 1 auto;
                display: flex;
                flex-direction: column;
                min-height: 0;
            }

            .last-page-block {
                page-break-before: avoid;

                    {% set bir_name = frappe.db.get_value("BIR CAS Settings", {"company": doc.company}, "name") %}

        <script>
        (function () {
            var PAGE_HEIGHT_MM = 273;
            var PAGE_BOTTOM_MARGIN_MM = 12;
            var BLOCK_MARGIN_MM = 5;
            var MM_TO_PX = 96 / 25.4;
            var SAFETY_PX = 8;
            var SINGLE_PAGE_HEIGHT_RATIO = 1.38;
            var MULTI_PAGE_MIN_HEIGHT_RATIO = 1.42;
            var SHORT_INVOICE_MAX_ITEMS = 15;
            var SHORT_INVOICE_HEIGHT_RATIO = 1.55;
            var MULTI_PAGE_ITEM_THRESHOLD = 12;

            function setPushHeight(px) {
                document.documentElement.style.setProperty(
                    '--last-page-push-height',
                    Math.max(0, px) + 'px'
                );
            }

            function getPageHeightPx() {
                return PAGE_HEIGHT_MM * MM_TO_PX;
            }

            function getDocTop(element) {
                var scrollY = window.pageYOffset || document.documentElement.scrollTop || 0;
                return element.getBoundingClientRect().top + scrollY;
            }

            function getItemCount(container) {
                var fromData = parseInt(container.getAttribute('data-item-count'), 10);
                if (!isNaN(fromData) && fromData >= 0) {
                    return fromData;
                }
                return container.querySelectorAll('.invoice-table tbody .table-row').length;
            }

            function fitsSinglePageHeight(scrollHeight, pageHeightPx) {
                return scrollHeight <= pageHeightPx * SINGLE_PAGE_HEIGHT_RATIO;
            }

            function isClearlyMultiPage(container, pageHeightPx) {
                if (container.scrollHeight > pageHeightPx * MULTI_PAGE_MIN_HEIGHT_RATIO) {
                    return true;
                }
                return getItemCount(container) > MULTI_PAGE_ITEM_THRESHOLD;
            }

            function pinSinglePageFooter(container) {
                var block = document.querySelector('.last-page-block');
                var group = document.querySelector('.last-page-footer-group');
                var push = document.querySelector('.last-page-push');
                if (!block || !group || !push) {
                    setPushHeight(0);
                    return;
                }

                block.classList.remove('footer-new-page');
                pinFooterToPageBottom(
                    block,
                    push,
                    group,
                    0,
                    getPageHeightPx(),
                    simulateTableLayout(container, getPageHeightPx()).blockStartOffset
                );
            }

            function applySinglePageMode(container) {
                container.classList.add('single-page-invoice');
                document.body.classList.add('single-page-invoice');
                pinSinglePageFooter(container);
            }

            function isSinglePageInvoice(container, pageHeightPx) {
                if (isClearlyMultiPage(container, pageHeightPx)) {
                    return false;
                }

                var naturalHeight = container.scrollHeight;
                if (fitsSinglePageHeight(naturalHeight, pageHeightPx)) {
                    return true;
                }

                var itemCount = getItemCount(container);
                if (
                    itemCount <= SHORT_INVOICE_MAX_ITEMS &&
                    naturalHeight <= pageHeightPx * SHORT_INVOICE_HEIGHT_RATIO
                ) {
                    return true;
                }

                container.classList.add('single-page-invoice');
                document.body.classList.add('single-page-invoice');
                var flexHeight = container.scrollHeight;
                container.classList.remove('single-page-invoice');
                document.body.classList.remove('single-page-invoice');
                return fitsSinglePageHeight(flexHeight, pageHeightPx);
            }

            function getOuterHeight(element) {
                if (!element) {
                    return 0;
                }
                var style = window.getComputedStyle(element);
                var marginTop = parseFloat(style.marginTop) || 0;
                var marginBottom = parseFloat(style.marginBottom) || 0;
                return element.offsetHeight + marginTop + marginBottom;
            }

            function wrapSplittableHeight(used, height, pageHeightPx) {
                used += height;
                while (used >= pageHeightPx) {
                    used -= pageHeightPx;
                }
                return used;
            }

            function addAvoidBreakSegment(used, height, pageHeightPx) {
                if (height <= 0) {
                    return used;
                }
                if (used > 0 && used + height > pageHeightPx) {
                    used = 0;
                }
                return used + height;
            }

            function simulateTableLayout(container, pageHeightPx) {
                var table = container.querySelector('.invoice-table');
                var result = {
                    usedAfterRows: 0,
                    blockStartOffset: 0
                };
                if (!table) {
                    return result;
                }

                var used = Math.max(0, getDocTop(table) - getDocTop(container));
                used = wrapSplittableHeight(0, used, pageHeightPx);

                var thead = table.querySelector('thead');
                if (thead) {
                    used = addAvoidBreakSegment(used, getOuterHeight(thead), pageHeightPx);
                }

                var rows = table.querySelectorAll('tbody .table-row');
                for (var i = 0; i < rows.length; i++) {
                    used = addAvoidBreakSegment(used, getOuterHeight(rows[i]), pageHeightPx);
                }

                result.usedAfterRows = used;
                var blockMarginPx = BLOCK_MARGIN_MM * MM_TO_PX;
                result.blockStartOffset = addAvoidBreakSegment(used, blockMarginPx, pageHeightPx);
                return result;
            }

            function getPageIndex(element, pageHeightPx) {
                return Math.max(0, Math.floor(getDocTop(element) / pageHeightPx));
            }

            function getOffsetOnPage(element, pageHeightPx, pageIndex) {
                pageHeightPx = pageHeightPx || getPageHeightPx();
                pageIndex = (pageIndex === undefined) ? getPageIndex(element, pageHeightPx) : pageIndex;
                return getDocTop(element) - (pageIndex * pageHeightPx);
            }

            function getRemainingAfterElement(element, pageHeightPx, maxBottom, pageIndex) {
                var bottom = getOffsetOnPage(element, pageHeightPx, pageIndex) + element.offsetHeight;
                return Math.max(0, maxBottom - bottom);
            }

            function pxToMm(px) {
                return px / MM_TO_PX;
            }

            function applyPushSize(push, px) {
                var safePx = Math.max(0, px);
                setPushHeight(safePx);
                if (!push) {
                    return safePx;
                }
                var heightMm = pxToMm(safePx) + 'mm';
                push.style.display = 'block';
                push.style.flex = '';
                push.style.setProperty('height', heightMm, 'important');
                push.style.setProperty('min-height', heightMm, 'important');
                return safePx;
            }

            function applyFlexBottomPin(block, push, minHeightPx) {
                if (block) {
                    block.style.minHeight = pxToMm(Math.max(0, minHeightPx)) + 'mm';
                }
                setPushHeight(0);
                if (push) {
                    push.style.display = 'block';
                    push.style.flex = '1 1 auto';
                    push.style.height = 'auto';
                    push.style.minHeight = '0';
                }
            }

            function resetFooterPinStyles(block, group, push) {
                if (block) {
                    block.style.paddingTop = '';
                    block.style.minHeight = '';
                }
                if (group) {
                    group.style.marginTop = '';
                }
                if (push) {
                    push.style.display = '';
                    push.style.flex = '';
                    push.style.removeProperty('height');
                    push.style.removeProperty('min-height');
                }
            }

            function clearLayoutModes() {
                var container = document.querySelector('.receipt-container');
                var block = document.querySelector('.last-page-block');
                var group = document.querySelector('.last-page-footer-group');
                var push = document.querySelector('.last-page-push');
                if (container) {
                    container.classList.remove('single-page-invoice');
                }
                if (block) {
                    block.classList.remove('footer-with-table', 'footer-new-page');
                }
                resetFooterPinStyles(block, group, push);
                document.body.classList.remove('single-page-invoice');
                setPushHeight(0);
            }

            function applyNewPageBottomPin(block, group, push, pageHeightPx) {
                var maxBottom = pageHeightPx - (PAGE_BOTTOM_MARGIN_MM * MM_TO_PX);
                var groupHeight = group.offsetHeight || 0;
                block.classList.add('footer-new-page');
                block.style.paddingTop = '';
                applyFlexBottomPin(block, push, maxBottom);
                var spacerPx = Math.max(0, maxBottom - groupHeight - SAFETY_PX);
                if (spacerPx > 0) {
                    applyPushSize(push, spacerPx);
                    push.style.flex = '0 0 auto';
                }
            }

            function pinFooterToPageBottom(block, push, group, anchorPageIndex, pageHeightPx, contentStartOffset) {
                var maxBottom = pageHeightPx - (PAGE_BOTTOM_MARGIN_MM * MM_TO_PX);
                var groupHeight = group.offsetHeight || 0;
                var safeStartOffset = Math.max(0, Math.min(contentStartOffset, maxBottom - groupHeight - SAFETY_PX));
                var blockMinHeightPx = Math.max(groupHeight, maxBottom - safeStartOffset);
                block.classList.add('footer-with-table');
                applyFlexBottomPin(block, push, blockMinHeightPx);

                var spacerPx = Math.max(0, maxBottom - safeStartOffset - groupHeight - SAFETY_PX);
                if (spacerPx > 0) {
                    applyPushSize(push, spacerPx);
                    push.style.flex = '0 0 auto';
                }
            }

            function updateMultiPageFooter(container, pageHeightPx) {
                var push = document.querySelector('.last-page-push');
                var group = document.querySelector('.last-page-footer-group');
                var block = document.querySelector('.last-page-block');
                if (!push || !group || !block) {
                    return;
                }

                var maxBottom = pageHeightPx - (PAGE_BOTTOM_MARGIN_MM * MM_TO_PX);
                var groupHeight = group.offsetHeight;
                var layout = simulateTableLayout(container, pageHeightPx);
                var remainingAfterTable = Math.max(0, maxBottom - layout.usedAfterRows);
                var blockMarginPx = BLOCK_MARGIN_MM * MM_TO_PX;

                block.classList.remove('footer-with-table', 'footer-new-page');
                resetFooterPinStyles(block, group, push);

                if (groupHeight + blockMarginPx + SAFETY_PX > remainingAfterTable) {
                    applyNewPageBottomPin(block, group, push, pageHeightPx);
                    return;
                }

                pinFooterToPageBottom(
                    block,
                    push,
                    group,
                    0,
                    pageHeightPx,
                    layout.blockStartOffset
                );
            }

            function updateInvoiceLayout() {
                var container = document.querySelector('.receipt-container');
                if (!container) return;

                clearLayoutModes();

                var pageHeightPx = getPageHeightPx();

                if (isSinglePageInvoice(container, pageHeightPx)) {
                    applySinglePageMode(container);
                    return;
                }

                updateMultiPageFooter(container, pageHeightPx);
            }

            function scheduleLayout() {
                updateInvoiceLayout();
                window.requestAnimationFrame(function () {
                    updateInvoiceLayout();
                    window.requestAnimationFrame(updateInvoiceLayout);
                });
                window.setTimeout(updateInvoiceLayout, 50);
                window.setTimeout(updateInvoiceLayout, 200);
                window.setTimeout(updateInvoiceLayout, 500);
            }

            function schedulePrintLayout() {
                updateInvoiceLayout();
                window.requestAnimationFrame(function () {
                    updateInvoiceLayout();
                    window.requestAnimationFrame(function () {
                        updateInvoiceLayout();
                        window.setTimeout(updateInvoiceLayout, 0);
                        window.setTimeout(updateInvoiceLayout, 100);
                    });
                });
            }

            window.addEventListener('beforeprint', schedulePrintLayout);

            window.addEventListener('afterprint', function () {
                scheduleLayout();
            });

            if (window.matchMedia) {
                window.matchMedia('print').addListener(function (event) {
                    if (event.matches) {
                        schedulePrintLayout();
                    }
                });
            }

            if (document.readyState === 'loading') {
                document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', scheduleLayout);
            } else {
                scheduleLayout();
            }

            window.addEventListener('resize', scheduleLayout);
        })();
        </script>
